control._why: Vs control (wipes, counters, removal, flyers): threats that are hard to answer - uncounterable Surrak draws when targeted, Sandman comes back from the graveyard, Mole Man/Sapling make tokens from lands. Warg Tactics / Pick Your Poison kill flyers and enchantments. Cuts small creatures that die to wipes.

midrange._why: Vs creature midrange: more removal (Hard-Hitting Question) and Warg Tactics (kill a flyer or protect a threat). Cuts the weakest small creatures.

aggro._why: Vs aggro: more removal to win the early fight, plus a 4th Harmonizer.
